summary: Solidion Technology Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with a new institutional investor for a private placement of 750,000 common shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 1,583,000 shares. Combined purchase price is $15.00 per share / $14.9999 per pre-funded warrant, implying gross proceeds of ~$34.99 million. The transaction is expected to close June 9, 2026. Proceeds will support commercialization and working capital. Directors, officers, and >10% holders signed 45-day lock-ups. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
